q: A set A ⊆ ℝ is analytic (Σ¹₁) if it is:
opts: A continuous image of a Borel set (equivalently, of the Baire space ℕᴺ)
A countable union of closed sets
exp: Analytic sets are projections of Borel sets: A = {x : ∃y (x,y) ∈ B} for Borel B. Equivalently, A = f(ℕᴺ) for some continuous f. Not all analytic sets are Borel (Suslin's theorem characterizes Borel sets as those that are both analytic and co-analytic).
